coinbase.svg
Official Coinbase Wallet SDK standard wallet logo
https://github.com/coinbase/coinbase-wallet-sdk/blob/master/packages/wallet-sdk/src/assets/wallet-logo.ts
Decoded the standard SVG data URL, with width and height fixed to its 1024 viewBox

phantom.svg
Reused the project's existing Phantom official-logo asset at ../model-logos/phantom-wallet.svg
